description: Beautiful charts. Built with d3 and Marko — server-rendered, themeable with CSS variables.

files.content:
// CartesianGrid — recharts-parity SVG partial. Internal: rendered only by
// the per-chart tags, which thread the geometry ctx explicitly (Marko has
// no context primitive). Lines carry LITERAL stroke="#ccc" so the shadcn
// container selector [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]
// restyles them to stroke-border/50 — do not "fix" the hardcoded color.
import { xTicks, yTicks, type CartesianCtx } from "./math.ts";

export interface Input {
  ctx: CartesianCtx;
  /** Horizontal grid lines (default on — recharts <CartesianGrid vertical={false}/>). */
  horizontal?: boolean;
  vertical?: boolean;
}

<const/{ ctx, horizontal = true, vertical = false }=input/>

<g class="recharts-cartesian-grid">
  <if=horizontal>
    <g class="recharts-cartesian-grid-horizontal">
      <for|tick| of=yTicks(ctx)>
        <line
          stroke="#ccc"
          fill="none"
          x1=ctx.plot.x
          y1=tick.y
          x2=(ctx.plot.x + ctx.plot.width)
          y2=tick.y
        />
      </for>
    </g>
  </if>
  <if=vertical>
    <g class="recharts-cartesian-grid-vertical">
      <for|tick| of=xTicks(ctx)>
        <line
          stroke="#ccc"
          fill="none"
          x1=tick.x
          y1=ctx.plot.y
          x2=tick.x
          y2=(ctx.plot.y + ctx.plot.height)
        />
      </for>
    </g>
  </if>
</g>
